name: unity-karting-game
description: Welcome to PubNub Prix, Unity's Karting Microgame enhanced with features built using PubNub's Unity SDK.

paragraphs: Welcome to PubNub Prix, PubNub's Unity racing game integrated with PubNub.
This is a racing game built using PubNub's real-time network Unity API. The base game is Unity's Karting Microgame, which is intended for Unity developers to learn Unity and enhance.

The objective of the game is to complete three checkpoints and reach the finish line. Players enter a username, play the game, and if they win the game, they can submit and view their time and username in a leaderboard that updates in real-time, as well as chat with others in a Lobby Chat.
features: Functional Unity racing game, where users can drive their kart/character around a track, while avoiding obstacles and trying to obtain the fastest time.
Player's can enter in a username used as their identity when submitting their score or chatting with others in the lobby chat.
Lobby Chat where players can chat after finishing a race. A random profile picture is obtained through MultiAvatar's API for the player based on that player's username.
Simple profanity filter to filter profanity from the entered username and lobby chat. Replaces profanity with "" characters.
